<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="480" height="160" viewBox="0 0 480 160" role="img" aria-labelledby="strat-title strat-description">
  <title id="strat-title">Stratocaster single-coil pickup — top view</title>
  <desc id="strat-description">White pickup cover and white mounting ears with six flat exposed pole pieces. The black fiber base widens along the lower side, as seen from directly above. Transparent background.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="strat-white" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#f6f5f0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#deddd6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="strat-fiber" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#16171a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#303135"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="strat-pole-metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e7e5dd"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#c1c0b8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#aaa9a3"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <g id="strat-pole">
      <circle r="10.7" fill="url(#strat-pole-metal)" stroke="#4b4944" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <path d="M-6,-6 L5,5 M-7,-2 L2,7 M-2,-7 L7,2" fill="none" stroke="#f3f0e7" stroke-opacity="0.5" stroke-width="0.65"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
  <!-- Asymmetric fiber flatwork, broadening below the cover. -->
  <path d="M38,44 H442 A24,24 0 0 1 466,68 C466,83 456,94 441,98 L320,134 Q240,155 160,134 L39,98 C24,94 14,83 14,68 A24,24 0 0 1 38,44 Z
           M44,68 A6,6 0 1 0 32,68 A6,6 0 1 0 44,68 Z
           M448,68 A6,6 0 1 0 436,68 A6,6 0 1 0 448,68 Z"
        fill="url(#strat-fiber)" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#111215" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M71,105 L164,131 Q240,150 316,131 L409,105" fill="none" stroke="#55565a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Mounting ears are part of the white cover flange, not black tabs. -->
  <path d="M38,46 H442 A22,22 0 0 1 464,68 A22,22 0 0 1 442,90 H38 A22,22 0 0 1 16,68 A22,22 0 0 1 38,46 Z
           M44,68 A6,6 0 1 0 32,68 A6,6 0 1 0 44,68 Z
           M448,68 A6,6 0 1 0 436,68 A6,6 0 1 0 448,68 Z"
        fill="url(#strat-white)" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#bbb9b0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="63" y="27" width="354" height="82" rx="41" fill="url(#strat-white)" stroke="#b9b7af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M105,30 H375 A38,38 0 0 1 413,68" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M68,78 Q75,105 105,106 H375 Q400,106 410,86" fill="none" stroke="#ceccc3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g transform="translate(125 68)"><use href="#strat-pole"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(171 68)"><use href="#strat-pole"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(217 68)"><use href="#strat-pole"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(263 68)"><use href="#strat-pole"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(309 68)"><use href="#strat-pole"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(355 68)"><use href="#strat-pole"/></g>
  <!-- Small connection eyelets in the exposed flatwork. -->
  <g fill="#b79858" stroke="#17181a" stroke-width="1">
    <circle cx="221" cy="131" r="3.4"/>
    <circle cx="259" cy="131" r="3.4"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#d6d2c5"><circle cx="221" cy="131" r="1.5"/><circle cx="259" cy="131" r="1.5"/></g>
</svg>
$values.name: Singlecoil pickup

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="240" height="260" viewBox="0 0 240 260" role="img" aria-labelledby="pot-title pot-description">
  <title id="pot-title">Guitar potentiometer — schematic top view</title>
  <desc id="pot-description">Round metal potentiometer housing with an unobstructed center for a schematic label, brown insulating terminal board and three solder lugs with transparent holes. Transparent background.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="pot-housing" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef0f1"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#cdd2d6"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#a7afb5"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d9dde0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pot-rim" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.2" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f7f8f9"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#929ca4"/>
      <stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#e0e4e7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#79848e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pot-terminal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a8afb3"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#f1f2ee"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#929b9f"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <g id="pot-lug">
      <path d="M-10,194 H10 V239 Q10,245 4,245 H-4 Q-10,245 -10,239 Z
               M-4,222 V234 A4,4 0 0 0 4,234 V222 A4,4 0 0 0 -4,222 Z"
            fill="url(#pot-terminal)" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#40474c" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M-6,207 H6" fill="none" stroke="#747d83" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>
    <g id="pot-crimp">
      <path d="M-8,-82 H8 L7,-73 H-7 Z" fill="url(#pot-rim)" stroke="#747e86" stroke-width="1.1" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
  <!-- Phenolic board and three independent solder terminals. -->
  <rect x="44" y="164" width="152" height="43" rx="10" fill="#9e633f" stroke="#4c3327" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M51,199 H189" fill="none" stroke="#c18a60" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g transform="translate(70 0)"><use href="#pot-lug"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(120 0)"><use href="#pot-lug"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(170 0)"><use href="#pot-lug"/></g>
  <g fill="#d2b47a" stroke="#64482e" stroke-width="1.2">
    <circle cx="70" cy="197" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="120" cy="197" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="170" cy="197" r="4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Stamped circular housing; the center is left clear for a label. -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="106" r="86" fill="url(#pot-rim)" stroke="#343b41" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="120" cy="106" r="79" fill="url(#pot-housing)" stroke="#8a949c" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <path d="M47,91 A75,75 0 0 1 156,40" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <g transform="translate(120 106)">
    <use href="#pot-crimp"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(60)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(120)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(180)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(240)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(300)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
$values.name: Pot

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="440" height="210" viewBox="0 0 440 210" role="img" aria-labelledby="selector-title selector-description">
  <title id="selector-title">5-polohový gitarový prepínač — pohľad zospodu</title>
  <desc id="selector-description">Štylizovaný spodný pohľad na otvorený gitarový blade prepínač. Dve oddelené rady po štyroch spájkovacích očkách, izolačné doštičky a kovový rám. Ovládacia páčka je na odvrátenej strane. Priehľadné pozadie a otvory. Body pripojenia A1 až A4: (112,36), (168,36), (224,36), (280,36); B1 až B4: (140,174), (196,174), (252,174), (308,174). Identifikátory kontaktov neurčujú ich elektrickú funkciu.</desc>
  <defs>
    <g id="selector-bottom-lug">
      <path d="M-10 39 V-4 Q-10 -12 -2 -12 H2 Q10 -12 10 -4 V39 Z M-4 -3 V4 A4 4 0 0 0 4 4 V-3 A4 4 0 0 0 -4 -3Z" fill="#bfc2c4" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
  <!-- Mounting strap lies behind the switch mechanism. -->
  <path d="M31 84 H409 Q421 84 421 96 V114 Q421 126 409 126 H31 Q19 126 19 114 V96 Q19 84 31 84Z M47 105 A7 7 0 1 0 33 105 A7 7 0 1 0 47 105Z M407 105 A7 7 0 1 0 393 105 A7 7 0 1 0 407 105Z" fill="#a7a7a7" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <!-- Solder tabs extend outward from the two insulating wafers. -->
  <g id="terminal-A1" transform="translate(112 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-A2" transform="translate(168 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-A3" transform="translate(224 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-A4" transform="translate(280 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B1" transform="translate(140 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B2" transform="translate(196 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B3" transform="translate(252 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B4" transform="translate(308 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <!-- Parallel phenolic terminal boards, seen edge-on from underneath. -->
  <g fill="#c88c5c" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="82" y="65" width="276" height="24" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="82" y="121" width="276" height="24" rx="4"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#a7a7a7" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.6">
    <circle cx="112" cy="77" r="4"/><circle cx="168" cy="77" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="224" cy="77" r="4"/><circle cx="280" cy="77" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="140" cy="133" r="4"/><circle cx="196" cy="133" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="252" cy="133" r="4"/><circle cx="308" cy="133" r="4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Lower metal cage; the player-facing lever is hidden on the far side. -->
  <rect x="77" y="88" width="286" height="34" rx="5" fill="#d0d1d2" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <path d="M105 95 H335 V115 H105Z" fill="#777b7e" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <path d="M119 99 H321 V111 H119Z" fill="#45494c"/>
  <path d="M204 95 H236 V115 H204Z" fill="#a7a7a7" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <g fill="#a7a7a7" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.5">
    <circle cx="91" cy="105" r="4"/><circle cx="349" cy="105" r="4"/>
  </g>
</svg>
$values.name: 5 way strat switch
